title: Obtain title and loan quantity in parallel
goal: Use Promise.all to wait for multiple independent results together and handle any failure.
summary: data card needs to obtain the title and quantity from two interfaces. Practice using local Promise to simulate different return sequences.
tasks: completes catalogCard(title, total) and starts readTitle(title) and readTotal(total) in parallel.
returns { title, total }, the order has nothing to do with the completion of the interface. Returns null if any of them fail.

example.note: is several Promises, and the completed array is arranged in the order passed in. When any Promise is rejected, the entire wait is also rejected.

hint: Put the two calls in the same Promise.all array, and use destructuring to get the values ​​in a fixed order.
